cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Six of them together form a full-fledged Pokémon. It's often hunted by Crabrawler, but uses psychokinesis to drive it off.

cards.name: Gogoat
cards.description: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.description: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

cards.name: Noivern
cards.description: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles. It swoops out of the dark to attack.

cards.name: Pheromosa
cards.description: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak
cards.description: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.description: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.description: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

cards.name: Braixen
cards.description: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

cards.name: Delphox
cards.description: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degree Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.description: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.description: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor
cards.description: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.description: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.description: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.description: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

cards.name: Clauncher
cards.description: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can shatter rock.

cards.name: Clawitzer
cards.description: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

cards.name: Amaura
cards.description: This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land where there were no violent predators like Tyrantrum.

cards.name: Aurorus
cards.description: Using its diamond-shaped crystals, it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent's attack.

cards.name: Bergmite
cards.description: Using air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit, they freeze opponents solid. They live in herds above the snow line on mountains.

cards.name: Snover
cards.description: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

cards.name: Avalugg
cards.description: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back makes it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

cards.name: Volcanion ◇
cards.description: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.description: When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokémon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.description: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokémon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.description: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.description: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.description: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

cards.name: Xurkitree
cards.description: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.description: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Uxie
cards.description: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

cards.name: Mesprit
cards.description: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.

cards.name: Azelf
cards.description: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf all came from the same egg.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.description: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.description: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.description: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.description: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.description: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.description: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

cards.name: Scatterbug
cards.description: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.description: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.description: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

cards.name: Skrelp
cards.description: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.

cards.name: Dragalge
cards.description: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

cards.name: Hoopa
cards.description: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

cards.name: Poipole
cards.description: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.description: The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead mother. According to some, it will evolve when it comes to terms with the pain of her death.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.description: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.description: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

cards.name: Scatterbug
cards.description: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

cards.name: Gible
cards.description: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.description: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.description: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.description: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.description: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

cards.name: Binacle
cards.description: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

cards.name: Barbaracle
cards.description: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

cards.name: Tyrunt
cards.description: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up an automobile. It lived 100 million years ago.

cards.name: Tyrantrum
cards.description: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.

cards.name: Spewpa
cards.description: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.description: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.description: This is Zygarde's form when about 10% of its cells have been gathered. It runs across the land at speeds greater than 60 mph.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.description: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

cards.name: Diancie ◇
cards.description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.description: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.description: Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.

cards.name: Buzzwole
cards.description: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.description: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements. It's eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

cards.name: Vivillon
cards.description: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

cards.name: Guzzlord
cards.description: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.description: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.description: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

cards.name: Floette
cards.description: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

cards.name: Florges
cards.description: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.

cards.name: Sylveon
cards.description: When this Pokémon sights its prey, it swirls its ribbonlike feelers as a distraction. A moment later, it pounces.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.description: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.description: It inserts its horn into chinks in metal, absorbing metal ions. For some reason, it collects keys.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.description: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

cards.name: Goomy
cards.description: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it needs some thorough hand-washing.

cards.name: Goomy
cards.description: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it needs some thorough hand-washing.

cards.name: Sliggoo
cards.description: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved, it slurps them up.

cards.name: Goodra
cards.description: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

cards.name: Arceus ◇
cards.description: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.description: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.

cards.name: Diggersby
cards.description: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it's finished digging, it lounges lazily.

cards.name: Furfrou
cards.description: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.
